title: Homemade Greek Yogurt Parfait 🥣🍯 high protein #shorts

segments.moment_description: Getting ready to make yogurt at home
Straining the yogurt thick and creamy
Layering yogurt with fruit and granola
Sharing the creamy Greek yogurt parfait

description:
Homemade Greek Yogurt 🥣🍯 — thick, creamy yogurt strained at home and layered with fruit, honey and granola into a high-protein parfait. Simple, wholesome and so satisfying.

Honey or maple on top? 👇 Tell me your pick!

🌿 Made by straining homemade yogurt till thick, then layering with fresh berries, granola and a drizzle of honey — naturally high in protein.

Did you know? Straining regular yogurt removes the watery whey and roughly doubles the protein — that's the whole secret behind thick Greek yogurt.
